long_biography.plain_text:
Replacement parts became an unexpected growth engine for Larry Keith at ENTEK. The company was repairing worn screws and barrels to keep its battery-separator lines operating when outside plastics manufacturers began asking to buy the same components. Keith recognised the demand and helped turn that workshop solution into a commercial extruder division.

His preparation was unusually practical. As a teenager, Keith cleaned a neighbour's machine shop, learnt welding and machining, and built his own workshop before supplying parts to ENTEK founder Jim Young. He joined the company in 1986, later became Young's partner and helped reunite its separator and machinery businesses under one group. As chief executive, he now directs manufacturing across battery-separator technologies, extruders and material-handling systems.

uncertainties.detail: Many unrelated Larry Keith profiles appear in public search. The resolved person is the ENTEK executive because the immutable LinkedIn names ENTEK and Florida filings place Larry Keith at the exact same Lebanon, Oregon address for both the owner-record management entity and ENTEK Manufacturing. Official leadership, government ownership and an independent interview complete the chain.

ENTEK was founded by Jim Young, not Larry Keith. Keith joined in the early company period, developed production operations, became Young's partner and later acquired other partners' interests. Operator therefore describes his relationship more accurately than Founder.

ENTEK announced an external majority investment in 2025, while its current leadership page continues to call Keith an owner and chief executive and a 2026 Florida filing retains his authorised-person role. The exact size and structure of his current equity are not public, so no controlling or majority ownership claim is made.

The direct interview establishes a self-built workshop, progression from supplier and employee to partner, and the purchase of other partners' interests. It does not provide enough reliable family-background or starting-capital detail to distinguish an independent from an advantaged start, so broad Self-made is retained.

Public sources do not securely establish Keith's middle name, exact birthplace, birth date or a secondary nationality. A trade interview gives age-based career context and weak executive aggregators offer an approximate age, but neither supports an exact birth-field proposal. Existing American nationality, United States residence, male gender and Alive status are not reproposed.

The existing LinkedIn is reverified by its ENTEK affiliation and exact official-role match, so it is not duplicated as a proposal. Searches found no securely verified personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website; the official ENTEK domain is proposed under the distinct Company Website type.

The biographies exclude vessel facts, current deal values, grant amounts, construction costs, employment projections, ownership percentages, private family circumstances, addresses, politics, trade advocacy, allegations, controversies, legal matters and other transient or sensitive material.
